title: Where Privacy Belongs: Placement Diagnosis and Certified Selection for Private Counterfactual Explanations on Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2609.37667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Counterfactual explanations for graph neural networks (GNNs) find the minimal intervention that flips a node's prediction--but computing one requires reading sensitive graph structure, and releasing it discloses that structure. Both existing placements fail. Privatizing the graph before explaining corrupts the target on exactly the borderline nodes needing recourse, manufacturing spurious flips that flip the privatized graph but not the true one. Explaining on the clean graph and perturbing the released explanation resists certification: re-auditing the standard heuristic shows an implied full-release budget of 573--753 on Cora and 256 on CiteSeer--orders of magnitude beyond its advertised budget--with worst-case single-entry leakage at AUC 1.0. We propose PrivCFS, which replaces certification-by-optimization with certification-by-construction: counterfactual selection over a fixed, data-independent candidate universe--edge interventions

translated_title: 隐私应归何处：图上私有反事实解释的放置诊断与可认证选择
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNN）的反事实解释旨在找到能够翻转节点预测的最小干预——但计算这样的解释需要读取敏感的图结构，而发布解释则会泄露该结构。现有的两种放置方案均告失败。先对图进行私有化再解释，恰恰会破坏那些最需要补救途径的边缘节点上的目标，制造出虚假的翻转——即在私有化图上翻转了预测，但在真实图上并未翻转。而在干净的图上解释后再对发布的解释进行扰动，则无法通过认证：对标准启发式方法的重新审计表明，其在Cora数据集上隐含的完全发布预算为573–753，在CiteSeer上为256——比其宣称的预算高出数个数量级——且最坏情况下的单条目泄露AUC达到1.0。我们提出PrivCFS，用“构造式认证”取代“优化式认证”：在一个固定的、与数据无关的候选全集中进行反事实选择——边干预……
tldr: 该论文诊断出现有图上私有反事实解释的两种放置方案均存在致命缺陷——先私有化会破坏边缘节点的补救效果，解释后扰动则存在远超宣称预算的泄露风险——并提出PrivCFS，通过在与数据无关的固定候选全集中进行构造式认证的反事实选择，同时保证解释有效性与隐私可认证性。
en_tdlr: The paper diagnoses that both existing placements for private counterfactual explanations on graphs fail—pre-privatization corrupts recourse for borderline nodes while post-hoc perturbation resists certification with severe leakage—and proposes PrivCFS, which replaces certification-by-optimization with certification-by-construction over a fixed, data-independent candidate universe of edge interventions.
